subject: Futuristic adult woman
status: Revised temporal sequence with scoped native visual review; exact final source independently cold-opened and exported to RGBA identical to the current public PNG sheet.
source_method: Built-in image generation with an authored native Pixelorama limb-ownership pose guide and approved face reference, followed by native draft registration, identity re-layering and actual shoulder/hand/kneepad pixel finishing. This is not a blank-canvas redraw or a duplicate-pose translated animation.

layers.role: Eight distinct pose-guided generated body/limb drafts, registered with binary alpha and original head removed.
Recognizable generated face, hair and earpiece re-layered consistently; coral near-kneepad markers, glove chevrons, knuckle and outline cleanup.
Authored near shoulder seam, crossing sleeve cuff, and far-side sleeve material/occlusion in forward arm poses 2/3/4.

palette_policy: No artistic color-count cap or source palette quantization. GIF uses its required indexed format palette.
costume_update: The new pose-guided draft is a coordinated variant of the approved concept: white cropped jacket, navy trousers, cyan/white guards, violet hair/eyes and earpiece retained; sleeve cuts, exposed midriff and knee/shin-guard shapes changed. Not pixel-identical costume preservation.

normalization.method: Native per-pixel draft registration preserves distinct limb poses and stabilizes pelvis/face placement.

independent_cold_source_check.scope: Final PXO fidelity only; motion and appearance review are separate.

visual_review.scope: All eight full frames at native/2x, native6x shoulder-to-fist crops, knee/hand/face details, every adjacent transition and frame7 to frame0. Technical export checks do not establish artistic approval.
observations: Near leg now changes from forward contact through push/back-fold to recovery/forward reach rather than repeating the same half-cycle.

Near shoulder visibly leads into the front crossing white sleeve in frames2/3/4; rear sleeve recedes behind it. Passing near-hand poses1/5 are similar silhouettes traveling in opposite temporal directions.
The recognizable same face/hair/earpiece remains layered consistently through the motion; the torso does not switch to a back view.
Targeted native patches repair glove/knuckle contours and keep a coral mark on the same near knee through occlusion.

transitions.next: Near foot accepts weight, knee flexes; near arm travels from rear toward passing.
Near leg passes backward under the pelvis while the far knee lifts; near sleeve begins crossing forward.
Near knee continues behind; far shin starts extending forward. Near arm holds its forward extreme briefly.
Far foot lands; the near folded leg remains behind, no torso side change.
Near heel recovers forward; near fist lowers toward passing.
Near knee rises in front; near arm continues rearward. This passing silhouette resembles frame1, with opposite temporal direction.
Near shin extends for landing while far leg folds behind.
Loop to frame0: near heel lands; same side/face retained, no swap of near/far identity.

visual_review.limits: Scoped visual review of this small eight-pose example, not a blanket aesthetic or anatomical guarantee. Similar passing poses and generated cloth variations remain; playable state-machine integration and blending were not implemented.

residual_limits: The detailed costume is an updated generated variant, not an exact copy of the concept sheet.
Passing poses1/5 intentionally have similar silhouettes; their opposite motion direction is established by neighboring poses.
The native source retains a generated body base, with actual editable correction layers; individual limb parts are not fully separated.
The 8-frame loop is a README demonstration, not a certified anatomical reference or complete game animation controller.

metadata_sanitization.scope: Only export_directory_path cleared in data.json; all non-data.json ZIP payloads preserved byte-for-byte, with a private original backup.
